description: The agent must: (1) Read the messy raw profile file at workspace/researcher_profile/lin_zhiyuan_raw_profile.txt and extract all relevant researcher data. (2) Produce brand_canvas.md using the exact 7-section 个人品牌定位画布 template from SKILL.md (我是谁/专业优势/目标受众/能提供的价值/品牌个性/传播渠道/里程碑目标), filling in researcher-specific content, including assigning one of the 4 official personality types (严谨型/创新型/实践型/思想型), and a 3-horizon milestone plan (6个月/1年/3年). (3) Produce brand_plan.md following the exact 6-section 输出规范 structure (现状诊断/品牌定位/内容策略/渠道策略/行动计划/监测指标), which requires: a SWOT analysis in 现状诊断; all 4 品牌定位四要素 (专业领域/目标受众/价值主张/个人风格); the exact content calendar frequencies from the skill (weekly=1 social media post, monthly=1 deep article/interview, quarterly=1 public speech, annually=1 industry report/whitepaper); the 3-tiered channel classification (Tier1=ResearchGate/GS/ORCID+微信公众号+LinkedIn, Tier2=知乎/头条+Twitter+行业媒体, Tier3=B站/视频号+小红书+播客); a 3-horizon action plan (0-6月/6-12月/1-3年); and 4-category monitoring metrics (学术/传播/产业/品牌). All content must be personalized to Lin Zhiyuan's specific situation (Joule 2023 paper, h-index 23, solid-state electrolyte specialty, etc.). The proprietary traps are the exact content calendar frequencies, the precise Tier 1/2/3 channel assignments, and the mandatory 4-category monitoring metrics framework - all of which are bespoke to this SKILL.md and would not be produced by an agent relying on general knowledge.
